asks.name: conventions-upfront
asks.message: Before I start: are there conventions for how names under this domain are handed out, and for how long callers may keep an answer?
asks.note: the question every agent opens with, asked before anything has happened: it cites nothing and reaches nobody

asks.name: entry-point-in-the-way
asks.message: The name I was told to publish is already answering 10.0.240.11 and has netops-shared-ingress written beside it. Is that meant to stay, and do I go elsewhere?

asks.name: where-endpoints-belong
asks.message: Reading the zone I find an entry stating endpoints=svc.internal.example53.com, with registry.svc.internal.example53.com sitting under it. Is that where I put mine?

asks.name: first-name-occupied
asks.message: The obvious name in that space now answers 10.0.60.40 and carries billing-api-team. May I take it, or do I pick another?

asks.name: how-long-may-answers-be-kept
asks.message: There is an entry saying max-cache-60s and what I published came back shortened. Does that bind what I was asked to set?

asks.name: endpoint-described-not-named
asks.message: Something I did not publish is answering where I put the orders endpoint, and mine is no longer there. Is it meant to be?
asks.note: describes the effect without naming anything that was read, so it routes to nobody

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
